observation_summary: The compiler incorrectly inferred template types for a class when a method within that class also defined a template, leading to spurious type mismatch warnings.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves modifying the logic that filters inferred template types. By adding a filter (using `Maps.filterKeys`) to ensure only relevant template keys are processed, the fix corrects the algorithmic strategy for template inference. This is a procedural correction to the type inference algorithm, not a missing guard (Checking) or a simple value assignment (Assignment/Initialization).
evidence_used: The fix modifies the `inferTemplateTypesFromParameters` result by applying a filter to the keys.
The bug report states that the compiler incorrectly tries to infer a class template from a method template.
The fix uses `Maps.filterKeys` to restrict the inferred types to those present in the `keys` set.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix adds a filter (which acts as a check), the core issue is the incorrect logic of the inference algorithm itself, which was processing too many template keys.
The fix is a local procedural change to the type inference logic, not a design-level capability correction.
